title: Global Patent & IP Enforcement Actions Monitor Configuration

sources.title: Sources to extract
sources.description: uspto_ptab = real USPTO PTAB Trial proceedings (IPR/PGR/CBM/DER), newest-filed-first, via the USPTO Open Data Portal. epo_opposition = EPO Open Patent Services opposition-family legal-status watch for a caller-supplied list of EP publication numbers (epWatchlist). Both require the matching credential fields below (BYOK) -- see this actor's README/src/http.ts for the live-verified access requirements of each.

usptoOdpApiKey.title: USPTO Open Data Portal API key
usptoOdpApiKey.description: Required when sources includes uspto_ptab. Bring-your-own-key: obtain a free key from a USPTO.gov account (MFA required) at https://data.uspto.gov/apikey -- this actor never attempts to create that account on your behalf. Never logged or persisted beyond this run.

epoOpsConsumerKey.title: EPO OPS Consumer Key
epoOpsConsumerKey.description: Required when sources includes epo_opposition. From a free developers.epo.org account + registered App (OAuth2 client-credentials flow). Never logged or persisted beyond this run.

epoOpsConsumerSecret.title: EPO OPS Consumer Secret
epoOpsConsumerSecret.description: Paired with epoOpsConsumerKey. Never logged or persisted beyond this run.

epWatchlist.title: EP publication numbers to watch (OPS epodoc format)
epWatchlist.description: Required when sources includes epo_opposition -- EPO OPS has no bulk 'recent oppositions' search, only a per-publication-number legal-status lookup, so this actor issues one sequential, independently-retried HTTP call per entry. Capped at 100: maxItemsPerSource only limits matched opposition events, not entries walked, so an uncapped watchlist can exceed the run's timeout budget on backoff sleeps alone when little/nothing matches -- see src/sources/epoOpposition.ts for the arithmetic. Example: "EP3000000".

trialTypeCodes.title: PTAB trial types to include
trialTypeCodes.description: Filters uspto_ptab results by trialMetaData.trialTypeCode. Leave empty for all four: Inter Partes Review (IPR), Post-Grant Review (PGR), Covered Business Method (CBM), Derivation (DER).

dateRange.title: Filter PTAB proceedings by recency (petition filing date)
dateRange.description: Optionally restricts uspto_ptab results to proceedings whose petitionFilingDate falls within this window (applied server-side as an ODP rangeFilter). Does not affect epo_opposition, which is watchlist-driven.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max records per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Hard cap on how many records to return per selected source this run (applied independently to uspto_ptab and epo_opposition).

onlyNew.title: Delta mode - only new or changed records since last run
onlyNew.description: When enabled, persists seen record ids and a status fingerprint between runs (in this actor's own key-value store) and skips records whose status is unchanged since the prior run. A first-seen record is emitted as event_type SANCTION; a previously-seen record whose status/decision fields changed is emitted as UPDATED; a uspto_ptab record whose terminationDate newly became set since it was last seen is emitted as the more specific TERMINATED instead. Recommended for recurring monitoring.
